Provider correctly wraps the root component in `src/main.tsx`, making the store available to the entire app.
improvements: In `src/main.tsx`, remove the `.ts` extension from the store import: `import { store } from './store/store'`. The bundler will not resolve `./store/store.ts` correctly.
Add an `index.ts` in the `store` folder that re‑exports `store`, `RootState`, and `AppDispatch`. This simplifies imports elsewhere (`import { store } from './store'`).
